blocks.title: if-elif-else statement
blocks.text: if-elif-else statement kai sharait baari baari jaanchta aur pehli sach shart ka block chalata hai; koi sach na ho to else chalta hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: weather = "cloudy" ke saath koi shart sach nahi, to program "Enjoy your day!" print karta hai.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: weather = "cloudy" se pehla sawal weather == "sunny"?; True ho to print("Wear sunglasses"). False ho to doosra sawal weather == "rainy"?; True ho to print("Take an umbrella"). Dono False hon to else: print("Enjoy your day!"). Teeno raaste aakhir mein Khatam par milte hain.
blocks.caption: if-elif-else ka bahao: sharait baari baari jaanchi jati hain (weather misal ka asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar se neeche chalein: pehle 'sunny' wali shart jaanchi jati hai. weather = "cloudy" hai, is liye yeh False hai aur hum neeche doosri shart 'rainy' par jate hain; yeh bhi False hai, is liye else wala block chalta hai aur "Enjoy your day!" print hota hai. Jo pehli shart True ho, sirf usi ka block chalta hai aur baqi chhor diye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Aisa program likhein jo number le kar bataye ke woh musbat, manfi ya sifar hai (long question 5; class activity).
blocks.explanation: num = float(input("Enter a number: ")); if num > 0: print("Positive") elif num < 0: print("Negative") else: print("Zero"). Sirf ek shaakh chalti hai, pehli sach shart ke mutabiq.

items: if-elif-else: sharait tarteeb se; pehla sach block chalta hai; else baqi ko sambhalta hai.
